name: questshelf.catalog.search
description: Search games across catalog or user-owned shelves by platform, genre, tag, max main-story hours, offline support, cross-play platforms, and co-op count.

name: questshelf.game.get
description: Read full game metadata, playtime breakdown, tags, asset_ids, MCP resource_uris for cover/HUD preview PNGs, and current user shelf status.

name: questshelf.asset.read
description: Read a verified cover/HUD visual preview PNG belonging to a game via Core ctx.assets.read.

name: questshelf.shelf.list
description: List the user's cross-platform game shelf entries, optionally filtered by status.

name: questshelf.preferences.get
description: Read the user's preferred platforms, muted tags, not-interested game IDs, avoid reasons, and HUD readability threshold.

name: questshelf.recommend.rank
description: Deterministically rank candidate games using shelf preferences, drop-reason penalties, muted tags, not-interested exclusions, and runtime constraints (including optional friend cross-play matching).

name: questshelf.friends.list
description: List friend profiles, their platforms, and their owned games for co-op matching.

name: questshelf.poll.list
description: List open and closed game-night polls. Polls past closes_at without poll.close remain status='open' with voting_expired=true.

name: questshelf.shelf.upsert
description: Create or update a user's shelf entry (backlog, playing, completed, dropped). Structured drop_reasons automatically enrich negative-feedback preferences.

name: questshelf.preferences.update
description: Update preferred platforms, muted tags, not-interested game IDs, avoid reasons, or minimum HUD font size.

name: questshelf.poll.create
description: Create a new game-night poll with validated candidate games and invited friends (at most one open poll per account).

name: questshelf.poll.update
description: Update title, candidate games, invited friends, max session minutes, or closing time on an open poll.

name: questshelf.poll.vote
description: Cast or update the current user's vote on an open game-night poll (voting twice updates rather than duplicates).

name: questshelf.poll.close
description: Close an open game-night poll and tally winning game IDs deterministically.
